test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Three persons namely Govind, Rahim and Sudhir can complete a work in 8, 12 and 15 days, respectively. The time taken to complete the work when they work together is:
solution:
Given:

Three persons namely Govind, Rahim, and Sudhir can complete the work in 8, 12, and 15 days, respectively. 

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken

Calculation:

LCM (8, 12, 15) = 120

Let the total work be 120 units.

Efficiencies,

Govind = 120/8 = 15 units a day

Rahim = 120/12 = 10 units a day

Sudhir = 120/15 = 8 units a day

Now, the time taken to complete the work when they work together

⇒ 120/(15 + 10 + 8)

⇒ 40/11 days

**∴ The time taken to complete the work when they work together is 40/11 days.**
